news.title: Nvidia beats on first earnings since CEO Huang's resignation; board won't reinstate him
news.text: Q3 FY27 revenue $115.8B (+103% y/y), EPS $2.70 vs $2.47 est., data-center revenue $107.6B; Q4 guide ~$130B +/-3% (spread over an extra week). First report since Jensen Huang resigned as CEO on 12 Nov; interim CEO Colette Kress (also CFO) stays in the role while the board searches for a permanent successor.
